messages:
maya: Quick thread — product wants a compact onboarding checklist for model entries that ops and eng can follow. Need something reproducible.

sam_k: happy to help. propose minimal gates: perf, quality, cost delta, and canary plan.

diego: Perf: record P50/P95 on our standard 8k bench, 3 runs. Flag if P95 > 300ms. Include peak memory.

anjali: Cost: offline estimator that compares marginal token cost to baseline. Should show batchability score and whether quantization helps.

maya: Compatibility: if embeddings/schema change, include a mapping doc and a tiny adapter in catalog to rewrite legacy requests.

sam_k: Canary suggestion: 1% 24h -> 5% 48h -> 25% 72h. Rollback triggers: P95 up 30% or error rate >0.5% or monitor eval quality drop >2%.

product-ops: ops note: pinning consumes capacity. we need pin types: soft (30d reclaimable) vs hard (manual). autoscaler should honor tags.

catalog-bot: reminder: onboarding ticket must attach raw bench logs, 3-run summary, cost report, canary JSON, and compat docs if any. Missing artifacts will block review.

maya: i'll turn this into a short onboarding template and share tomorrow. thanks all. :rocket:
